extracted.name: Poppy Seed Chicken
extracted.description: Sherry adds sweetness to this poppy seed chicken recipe that cooks in a sour cream sauce and is topped with cracker crumbs and an slew of poppy seeds.
ingredient_lines: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - diced
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Place chicken in the prepared baking dish. Combine soup, sour cream, and sherry in a bowl; pour or spoon over chicken. Season with salt and black pepper.
Combine crushed crackers and poppy seeds; sprinkle over chicken. Season with salt and black pepper. Drizzle melted butter over cracker layer. Cover baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 45 minutes, uncover for the last 5 minutes. Let stand before serving, 3 to 5 minutes.
